committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects emerging growth companies, securities issuers, and the Securities and Exchange Commission.
dimensions.evidence: Any issuer may confidentially submit to the Commission a draft registration statement for confidential nonpublic review

dimensions.assessment: Simplifies regulatory filing requirements and provides confidentiality options for securities registration.
dimensions.evidence: in the case of an emerging growth company, not more than the two preceding years

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are specified in the source text.
Amends the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 regarding registration statement contents and SEC review procedures.
dimensions.evidence: Section 12(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78l(b)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendment to federal securities law.

missing_information: The number of companies expected to utilize the confidential filing or two-year reporting provisions annually.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides statutory backing for emerging growth companies to submit two years of profit and loss statements instead of three, and allows any issuer to submit confidential draft registration statements to the SEC.
